items: compression ratio — Original size compared with compressed size.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Lossless compression represents data more efficiently without discarding any information and reconstructs the original exactly.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Lossy methods intentionally discard information; a decoded image/audio can be perceptually similar but not bit-for-bit identical.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Choose lossless for text, programs, records or medical numeric originals; lossy can be appropriate for delivery copies of photos/video/audio with acceptable quality reduction.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: An altered digit can identify a different record and corrupt its meaning.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model and check
blocks.text: Lossless encoding is essential; compression ratio depends on redundancy in the source.
